In a city where institutional and contracting employers concentrate, the credential becomes a practical asset for career progression and regional competitiveness.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Sierra Vista

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates hold a bachelor's degree plus documented hours leading projects. Granite PM Academy staff can help you assess whether your background meets PMI standards before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our course covers the PMBOK Guide framework, real-world scenarios, and exam-style questions. You'll earn all required contact hours in a structured program designed for working professionals balancing career and study.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Apply directly to PMI with proof of your education, experience, and completion of the 35-hour course. Pay the PMI exam fee at application. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the submission process and answer questions about documentation requirements.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and review sessions, to solidify your readiness. Schedule your PMP exam at a PMI-approved testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify challenging topics before you take the computer-delivered exam.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your certification active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training and learning opportunities that count toward PDU requirements, helping you stay current with project-management best practices.
